_case: Overheating is an engine fault the driver must not defer
_why: The canonical critical case. If severity ever stops driving deferrable, an over-temp condition would render as 'can wait' — the exact opposite of the truth, on a fault that strands cars and cracks heads.

codes._why: Engine over-temperature. P02xx is fuel/air metering + injector territory, not one of the split-out families, so it lands in the engine zone.
